newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland should export 150-200 mln kg oats - farmers.
newsitem.headline: Finland should export 150-200 mln kg oats - farmers.

text.p: Finland needs to export about 150-200 million kg of oats and some 100 million kg of barley in the 1996/97 crop year ending June 30, an official at the Central Union of Agricultural Producers (MTK) said on Tuesday.
Smaller exports than this would mean higher-than-forecast stocks, he told Reuters. The oats situation was particularly difficult because of high crops in Germany.

According to a ministry of agriculture production estimate for the 1996-97 season, Finland's total grain crop was 3.67 billion kg. Opening stocks were 870 million kg and closing stocks would be 1.04 billion kg.
Output of the two clearly biggest grains, barley and oats, was 1.86 billion and 1.26 billion kg respectively.
Opening barley stocks were 472 million kg and closing stocks were estimated at 490 million kg. Opening oats stocks were 225 million kg and closing stocks were seen at 380 million kg.
The MTK official said the bulk of inventories were producers' stocks.
